name: Clock Up Fan Disc 3GHz
source: In addition to new wallpapers, system voices and other extras, this fandisc features three side stories expanding the 'Defeated' ending in the Evil Route (Scenario 01), the Loli ending (Scenario 02) and the True ending (Scenario 03).
